name: Liao Shih-han
bio: Liao Shih-Han was graduated from the Department of Radio and Television, NCCU. After finishing the military service, he joined Rice Film Co. Ltd. Liao currently works as a freelance director and is known for Cigarette Ends and One Night Home.
